Framer became the default choice over Webflow, Squarespace, and custom React stacks for SaaS, B2B, and agency brands in the last 18 months. But its design freedom is also its danger. A site can ship looking gorgeous and convert nothing if information architecture, conversion paths, SEO, and CMS structure are not designed up front. That's why the difference between a Framer freelancer and a Framer agency matters: agencies bring the strategy on top of the build.
This guide compares the 7 best Framer agencies in 2026, with honest pros, cons, pricing, and a framework to pick the right partner for your marketing site.

How to choose the best Framer agency for your project
1) Greenfield site vs migration: which problem are you solving?

If you're building a new site from scratch, almost any agency in this list fits. If you're migrating from Webflow, WordPress, or a custom stack, the SEO and structure preservation work is its own specialty.
Greenfield: ManasFlow, BRIX, Analogue, South Digital, Deserve Studio
Your site can be a creative statement or a conversion machine. Best agencies do both, but most lean one way.
Brand-first / creative-led: BRIX, Analogue, Deserve Studio
3) Does the site need automations and AI features behind it?
A static brochure site is one thing. A site with lead capture flows, CRM sync, AI-powered chat or demo features, multilingual personalization, and conversion analytics is a different scope.
Static brochure: any agency in this list

For EU and MENA brands, multilingual is not a nice-to-have; it's the difference between converting your home market and abandoning half your pipeline.
Single language: any agency in this list

If you are evaluating Framer agencies and want a partner that handles the marketing site plus the lead-ops, AI features, and multilingual delivery, ManasFlow ships full conversion-tuned sites for SaaS startups and marketing agencies. Book a free discovery call to scope your site.

What is a Framer agency? A Framer agency is a team that specializes in designing and building production marketing sites and apps using Framer. They handle the work beyond drag-and-drop: information architecture, conversion design, CMS structure, SEO discipline, animation and interaction design, and integration with marketing automation, analytics, and CRM systems.

How much does it cost to hire a Framer agency? Project pricing typically ranges from $2,500 for a small landing page to $30,000+ for a full marketing site with CMS, animations, lead-ops integration, and multilingual support. Premium brand-led shops can run $50k+ for hero sites. Hourly rates fall in the $75-200/hr range.

Is Framer production-ready for enterprise marketing sites? Yes. Framer powers production marketing sites for many funded SaaS companies, including ones with significant SEO traffic. Enterprise-grade CMS work (multi-region, role-based content) is well within scope for agencies like MovingFrames.

Should I use Framer or Webflow? Framer for design-led marketing sites where animation, interaction, and creative ambition matter. Webflow for content-heavy sites with deep CMS requirements and a mature plugin ecosystem. Both are production-grade; the choice is about design DNA more than capability.

Can a Framer agency also handle my lead automation and CRM? Some can, most cannot. Pure Framer shops are good at the site but rarely have RevOps or automation engineering bench. If your site needs to wire into HubSpot/Salesforce, route leads, and integrate with a real revenue stack, pick an agency that includes custom workflow automation as a core service.

How long does a Framer agency take to ship a site? A small landing page ships in 1-2 weeks. A full marketing site with CMS, animations, and integrations typically takes 4-8 weeks. Migrations of large existing sites with SEO preservation can take 8-16 weeks.

Can I migrate from Webflow or WordPress to Framer without losing SEO? Yes, with discipline: URL mapping, 301 redirect plan, metadata preservation, structured data parity, and a post-launch monitoring period. MovingFrames specializes in this. Greenfield-only agencies are usually not the right pick for migrations with significant SEO at stake.

Is Framer good for multilingual sites? Yes. Framer supports multilingual sites natively. The architectural discipline (hreflang tags, locale-aware CMS structure, language switcher UX, SEO across locales) matters more than the platform. For EN/FR/AR or similar combinations, work with an agency that has shipped multilingual sites before, not one improvising for the first time.

Do I still need a Framer agency now that Framer 3.0 has AI agents built in? For most real marketing sites, yes. Framer's native AI agents (shipped June 2026) can design pages, edit components, and manage CMS content inside the canvas, which is genuinely useful for fast iteration. But they don't replace the strategy layer an agency brings: information architecture, conversion-path design, SEO discipline, and integrating the site with your CRM and lead-routing stack.
